snippet.title: Anticitizen Red trailer #2
snippet.description:
As seen in the 2025 Brutal Indies showcase!
Wishlist on steam now!

In an American occupied cyberpunk Australia; use bullet time, a whole bunch of weapons and movement mechanics to outwit biker gangs and face off the corporate police. Meet a unique cast of Aussie battlers, explore the new American empire, stay for the larrikin charm.
